Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The engineering and security teams at Acme would like a focused readout on the latency and throughput numbers from the pilot runs — ideally a 45-minute session with your SE and a 15-minute procurement/contract check after.

Can you share availability for next week? Our preferred stakeholders who need to attend: myself, Samir Kulkarni (engineering), Security Ops, and our procurement contact (cc'd). Also can you confirm what artifacts you can share up front (SOC 2 + high-level network egress notes)?

Goal: clear pass/fail on performance targets so we can proceed to procurement.

Thanks,

Hi Priya / Samir — looping in some quick technical notes in advance so the readout is productive.

1) What we'll bring:
- Short performance readout (p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, concurrency)
- Live run of one representative latency test with KV cache disabled and one batched throughput run
- Appendix with test harness config so you can reproduce locally

2) What we need from Acme for any on-prem/sandbox runs:
- Short list of representative prompts and expected token lengths
- If you want Redwood to run against any private datasets, we need a data access channel (S3 or secure upload) and a brief data spec (PII redaction expectations)

I've attached the test plan and a tiny sample server hostfile for any connectivity checks. We can also run purely against your synthetic samples if that's preferred.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
